summary: Examples of script: free-form and cmd usage, creates/removes guards, custom or system executables, and running a PowerShell script on Windows.
questions: How do I run a script only once using creates?
How do I run a .py script with python3 remotely?
How do I run a PowerShell script on Windows with Ansible?

answer_card.title: script examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/script.sh --some-argument 1234
- ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/create_file.sh --some-argument 1234
  args:
    creates: /the/created/file.txt
- ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/script.py
  args:
    executable: python3
- script: subdirectories/under/path/with/your/playbook/script.ps1
```
